verifications.claim: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 concluded with episode 12 (Sendai Colony) in March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'With the release of episode 12, titled "Sendai Colony," Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 officially came to an end' (Published Mar 26, 2026); R2: 'Jujutsu Kaisen season 3 episode 12 will indeed air next Thursday, March 26... final episode of the first cour'; R3: 'Jujutsu Kaisen season 3 episode 12 is the end of The Culling Game, Part 1... adapt the Sendai Colony Battle'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states Season 3 ended with episode 12 'Sendai Colony' in March 2026; R2 and R3 confirm episode 12 as finale of first cour/Sendai Colony in March 2026.

verifications.claim: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 ended after 12 episodes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'With the release of episode 12... Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 officially came to an end'; R2: 'The first twelve served as the first cour'; R3: 'The third season has officially completed its first cour'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Season 3 (or its first cour, treated as season end) concluded after 12 episodes.

verifications.claim: Reports suggest a delay until at least January 2027 for Jujutsu Kaisen Part 2/Season 4.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'According to a new report... may have booked all available anime slots through the remainder of the year... fans are speculating that we could be looking at a January 2027 return... The Culling Game, Part 2'; 'TOHO Animation has officially announced that Jujutsu Kaisen season 4 will replace the initially planned season 3 part 2'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly cites reports and speculation of January 2027 delay for Part 2/Season 4; other sources predict earlier but do not contradict.

verifications.claim: 2026 broadcast slots for the network are fully booked.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the show's home broadcast network in Japan, the MBS/TBS nationwide network, may have booked all available anime slots through the remainder of the year for other anime shows'
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly states the network booked all 2026 slots through year-end.

verifications.claim: Some reports suggested a shorter break for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 continuation
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Standard anime cour breaks can last between 3-4 months... could theoretically return in summer 2026, with July perhaps being the most likely'; R3: 'Standard anime cour breaks can last between 3-4 months'
verifications.reasoning: R2 reports suggest shorter break (3-4 months to summer 2026); matches 'some reports' even with longer speculation elsewhere.
